notes.title: What Did You Miss?
notes.content:
Thank you for your continued support of Midnight Monitor!

[h2]What Did You Miss?[/h2]
This update adds the very frequently requested "Missed Anomalies" feature. This is accessible from the Win/Lose screens and will show you which anomalies you missed, and in which rooms:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44506047/3c870f70146e09c9785cf78d44ed57e90f7a2093.png[/img]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44506047/cc6103cb0a424e97899c54a8c83e3b4e861639b4.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44506047/fd9e308744a86d7d966480e6222a04889b0d622f.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44506047/1f94e552af1655fef89e9d9a79d17384575c0f80.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44506047/a1ea38c27d1124094879683c2ae60f3f9f730741.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44506047/e3dafec41f174cec7e85dc5a77e8e2a98138c7cc.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44506047/9a94fe3bf0ec497836c2c949af19ba779ba3fa11.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44506047/8735003f38c2d4f5c9a45a852fba93fbe9d2fc17.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44506047/8348b31654d3bb7d51fd4c93722c304de2e929eb.png[/img][/url]

This will allow players to better understand what anomaly types and rooms are giving them the most trouble 😎

[h2]"Easy" and Hard Mode Changes[/h2]
The minimum number of cameras in the Neighbourhood House has been lowered to 4 (previously 6). This means that the game has been made easier for those who find it too challenging.

To balance this out, using fewer than 6 cameras will completely disable Hard Mode. Likewise, Hard Mode is now forced when using more than 8 Cameras. Hard Mode is still optional when using between 6 - 8 cameras.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44506047/60bda17173e5eba1867f78bf342397b8de5d7f64.jpg[/img]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44506047/bdba9a60a816b1a04e73539d3d00b75b9c942714.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44506047/ecc6580091a0c232a11b89b1ab19bd2ab45ca2ed.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Nerfed the Pumpkin King, Sorta...[/h2]
So it turns out the Pumpkin King COULD be unkillable. A bug existed where if you changed the number of cameras on the main menu and then enabled Halloween Mode, the Front Entrance might not be active. The Pumpkin King would still spawn, with no way to kill him.

This has now been fixed. Halloween Mode = Front Entrance = Pumpkin King. Nobody actually reported this bug to me - I just happened to find it by myself, but it seemed pretty nasty!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44506047/07639d607c2edcf39d4f53392dcfd777aa270e38.jpg[/img]

Please see the full list of Patch Notes below:

[h3]General:[/h3]
- Added "Missed Anomaly" reports to the Win/Lose screens detailing which anomalies and locations were missed during gameplay
- The "Unlimited" FPS Limit has been changed to "Vsync" to better explain its function. Selecting this mode will allow the framerate to match your monitor's refresh rate
- Removed the built-in mouse cursor

[h3]Modern House:[/h3]
Gameplay:
- The Kid's Room Flashlight has been brightened slightly

[h3]Neighbourhood House:[/h3]
Camera Selector updates:
- The minimum number of cameras has been reduced to 4 (previously 6)
- When playing with fewer than 6 cameras, Hard Mode is forced off
- When playing with greater than 8 cameras, Hard Mode is forced on

Halloween Mode Bugfixes:
- Previously when enabling Halloween Mode, it was possible for the Front Entrance camera to not work, and the Pumpkin King could not be defeated.
- Now the camera rotation is refreshed whenever Halloween Mode is enabled

Misc:
- The Tutorial/Intro tooltip has been updated
- The Anomaly Scanning function can no longer fail, and will always give the location of 1 or 2 anomalies

Bugs:
- Fixed an issue where the zoom blur would persist across camera changes

notes.title: Can you survive the Pumpkin King?
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44506047/db434af33082833ae6e39f49c8698b97ef8756ff.png[/img]

[i][b]Please see the addendum for updates on pricing and Halloween Event availability.
[/b][/i]
[b][h1]Can you survive the Pumpkin King?[/h1][/b]
It's almost Halloween, Midnight Monitors! You know what that means?

[i][h3]A Brand New Game Mechanic[/h3][/i]
It looks like the Neighbourhood House's security system has earned the ire of the Pumpkin King.

At random he will appear outside of the Front Entrance, and will slowly work his way closer to the house. It looks like he might be scared of light, but you'll have to flash him at the right time, or risk losing the game!

Be sure to check the Front Entrance curtain [i]very often[/i].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44506047/5b55b029125b4f9685d3b6246807132fd3a3d1f7.png[/img]

This change also comes with two new achievements. Can you unlock them?

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44506047/e9af9bb1185357a2fe757b49196a2c88d0575c6a.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44506047/bd984285b073e09123ad65410847840b620f0007.jpg[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44506047/922083bb4569c76790ecc179e7b457b563fe41ef.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44506047/f63cddc3cdeda2b192d527738e80e14e14b134f3.jpg[/img][/url]

[h3][i]Custom numbers of cameras[/i][/h3]

A feature has been added to increase (or reduce) the number of cameras active each night. Currently this goes as low as 6 cameras and as high as 9, with 3 more cameras coming soon!

(This does not change how many anomalies will spawn - Do you want lots of anomalies in fewer rooms, or fewer anomalies in a large number of rooms? Now the choice is all yours!)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44506047/b0e4079cd299077bec30456c8f15f6e5101b4832.png[/img]

[i][h3]Minor kitchen changes[/h3][/i]
To facilitate the custom camera changes above, the kitchen camera has been moved. This also means that some anomalies have also been changed to work with the new camera angle. Can you spot the differences?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44506047/dd1b11413cbdfe6fcd364e5bdd1effc8a11231e4.png[/img]

[h3]Patch Notes:[/h3]

[list]
[*] Added the Pumpkin King - Scare him away by clicking the flashlight on the table
[*] Added the ability to select how many cameras you want - This currently scales from 6 - 9 with more cameras on the way
[*] Changed the location of the kitchen camera
[*] Altered some Kitchen anomalies due to the new camera location
[*] Swapped the "OK" and "Scan" buttons as people habitually seem to click the leftmost button without reading the text box
[*] Minor bug fixes and changes to the codebase
[/list]

Thank you!

[h2]Addendum: Pricing Updates & Event Availability[/h2]

Please be aware that the price of Midnight Monitor will be changing following the conclusion of this sale period. The price will increase from $3.99 -> $5.99 (regional pricing will also vary).

Please also be aware that the Halloween event will also now be ending on November 4th.

notes.title: Halloween Event Update + SALE!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44506047/827e3d2d7548d0c943624b12a8458f199e96f6bd.png[/img]
[i][h1]Happy Halloween, Midnight Monitors![/h1][/i]

This latest update to Midnight Monitor brings a whole host of spooky surprises, including a complete overhaul of the Neighbourhood House, as well as new and varied anomalies to watch for and report.

Midnight Monitor's Halloween event will last until November 7th, includes three new achievements and a brand new camera.

[u][h2]MIDNIGHT MONITOR SALE DISCOUNT[/h2][/u]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2551780/Midnight_Monitor_Anomaly_Watch/

To celebrate the launch of Midnight Monitor's Halloween Update, Midnight Monitor will be on sale for 20% OFF until 2023/11/05! Get it while you can and enjoy the spooky festivities detailed below!

[u][h3]Neighbourhood House Spooky Theme[/h3][/u]
The entire Neighbourhood House level has been completely rethemed for the entirety of the Halloween event. Each room receives new spooky items, lighting and in some cases, new anomalies 🎃

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44506047/f592ac33fe54073ca7c96cb675de8aabf9ef51b3.png[/img][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44506047/7f4c71162d69954137d24258716305ade3a4a497.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44506047/d0292d28b62db56e40b283ada17d9ffbbeb85be8.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44506047/651fb03c545534424a8e744630adedcc7bec10ff.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44506047/67a9dfcf71a78105f4d22b8c0c20f5ed8cd43086.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44506047/46e3ca75d690b533a345e883400da84fffff74da.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44506047/d86e25bfdd548e2ee1138f637a43ac209912533e.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44506047/df76b4a4348dd91989333e75ecbd1fc42bdfb5b2.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44506047/d9172f91cbaaf2a67ce6991b0b5141f462a7ea28.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44506047/40a2460b6c3fbf86b15ba042be34c75079329999.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44506047/c37363805f41667dcf561c89f9c8c55a32f78f37.png[/img][/url]

[u][h3]An additional camera? 📹[/h3][/u]
In the spirit of the spooky season, a brand new camera has been added to the Front Entrance of the house! Who will come to visit you during your spooky observation sessions?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44506047/c6f785c792859d0e55bf06b130efd9341ca8729f.png[/img]

[u][h3]Do you dare peek behind the curtain?[/h3][/u]
In addition to the new Front Entrance camera, a new curtain peeking mechanic has been added - Just click on the curtain to peel it back, and pray that you don't gain the attention of anything hiding behind it 💀

[u][h3]Scary new achievements![/h3][/u]

notes.title: New Level + Gameplay Added!
notes.content:
Hi everyone, and thank you so much for your continued patience. Midnight Monitor has just been updated!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44506047/093864219919790c2a406d223469ba4cfd181e67.png[/img]

[h3]The Neighbourhood House has been added!
[/h3]

An Artificial Intelligence security system monitors every inch of this beautiful, secluded, high tech home. Armed with real-time threat detection technology, the residents of this illustrious home have nothing to fear with their lives firmly in the hands of their state-of-the-art AI defence system.

Or do they?

Uncover the secrets behind this spacious estate, as well as the true nature of "Sequre_OS".

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44506047/29402ea1752c4e01cca1f79b70f619200ef59522.png[/img]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44506047/187a2d1634ee9d96bca9a3f5f71793c97a63d737.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44506047/bb5f87b6c83ce09d9177b2592e08087ea6f4c4dd.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44506047/a769dcdd5b9ac41279cf62e8419e30c2edbd249a.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44506047/762a669d1002e5810e4d038b0151deff94413456.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44506047/1bb2cfab292e55e4fdc4e0e3dc88d9208e7e7119.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44506047/7233e85950df11f4a62b98759f7cb127e569c778.png[/img][/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44506047/f8f8c8e77e536e32fbdaf8e165b583bf4b8833c2.png[/img]

With this new house comes new anomaly types, as well as refinements to previous ones. Door Anomalies are now Displacements. Substitution Anomalies replace disappearances, and Time Manipulation adds an all new mechanic to the game. Abysmal and Presence Anomalies no longer end the game immediately, though they do make it much harder 😉

With this update, the total number of anomalies in the game so far is over 400, with many more planned to fill out the rest of this new house and beyond.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44506047/71d2aa73534c2c54a764cfd7473fa1743acfd10e.png[/img]

Currently exclusive to this new level is a new scanning mechanic that is not yet available anywhere else. If you see it, be sure to make use of it! It will only show up once and can give you a hint on where to find your next anomaly if you're having some trouble:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44506047/160cdd78ad20c454f8aaaaba8efb49156a9c4bef.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44506047/d8a4ecb920893fdd496a7ac66b464580ee6973ec.png[/img]

This brand new scanning feature can be a vital lifeline if you're unsure of where to look. It can give the locations of up to 2 anomalies, so don't miss out your chance to use it when you see it!

Be warned however, the scan can also fail, too. Honing your observation skills is, as always, the best way to beat the night.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44506047/914f0c1c38d7c7f8a83d51bb7739ad4902da039a.png[/img]

Replacing Black & White mode in the Neighbourhood House is Nightcam Mode:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44506047/b62e23f260a03612c14d878cef51ff56577a397f.png[/img]

The houses in Midnight Monitor are designed to be colourful and interesting to look at. This means that anomalies are typically designed to be much more easily seen through changes in colour and brightness, something that Black & White Mode completely removes.

Nightcam Mode changes the gameplay up by turning on night vision - Objects are lit with a single light and lose most (but not all) of their colour. In testing I have found this to be a very satisfying mode to use, and I hope that you do too! It turns out that colour is very important for humans to be able to spot changes, and the small amount of colour that Nightcam mode keeps is a game changer.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44506047/b0d7a35273998e74b013711232b1062c32ea849c.png[/img]

This new level is full of secret to find, including messages, text, sounds, cameo appearances and much more. Keep your eyes peeled and try not to get caught off-guard 😉

Full Patch notes for this update are below:

[list]
[*] New house level added: Neighbourhood House
[*] New Anomaly types added: Substitution, Time Manipulation
[*] Completely rewritten code and functionality to help make building the game easier and faster
[*] Secrets and easter eggs throughout the level
[*] 100+ additional anomalies, with many more planned
[*] A greater focus on optimisation. The new level looks fantastic and is fully playable on older laptops, and even the Steam Deck!
[*] A brand new lifeline mechanic: Scanning
[*] Interactable elements in the new level - Try moving your mouse around and see what you find!
[*] Multiple tweaks and fixes
[/list]

As this is a brand new major update, some functionality might be buggy or not functioning correctly. If you experience any issues please let me know as soon as possible by emailing viexigames@gmail.com or join the official Discord at https://discord.gg/qDxzxRQUfz.

notes.title: Game Mode Improvements + QoL Fixes
notes.content:
Thank you as always for your continued support of Midnight Monitor.

I have worked on some much needed Quality of Life fixes for the external camera, Dark Mode, Black & White Mode and Hard Mode.

[h3]The Back Yard[/h3]

The external cam has seen some much needed love. The view has been zoomed in and items have been shuffled around to work with this new viewport. It is now much easier to see the entire back yard.

In addition to this, the lighting has been drastically improved. Dark and previously hard-to-see objects now stand out much more readily, and frankly I just wish that this was my real back yard. Check out the changes below!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44506047/4da5fa92c9e38fdf9310a405ed4464fea55dbc3d.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44506047/140b9461497c06544580d3b5c3b47468de395c4d.png[/img]

Naturally the most important change is...

[h2]THE STATUE IN THE YARD HAS BEEN LIT UP[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44506047/e3eb2ea0e2c2684c74c4a84e2c6a13bda3c5f342.png[/img]

Hopefully you should get a lot less "PRESENCE IN THE GARDEN" chat messages when you stream this to your audience... :)

[h3]Visibility Changes[/h3]

Dark Mode and Black & White Mode have received some well needed adjustments, generally making the game much more visible when using either, or both in tandem.

[list]
[*] [u][b]Dark Mode[/b][/u] is now slightly darker, but the flashlight is now much brighter - You should find that this balances nicely and is a worthy upgrade for the mode's namesake
[*] Dark Mode has also had the range of the flashlight increased up to 25m, meaning it is now much more suited for using on the External Cam
[*] [u][b]Black & White Mode[/b][/u] has had its levels tweaked - Shadows have been raised and Highlights lowered, leading to a much more consistent image and generally making changes much easier to spot
[/list]

[h3]Hard Mode[/h3]

Yes, another update to Hard Mode. It turns out Hard Mode went from way too hard, to way too easy. Most people are now clearing Hard Mode after 1 round, so the difficulty has been increased again:

[list]
[*] [u][b]Hard Mode[/b][/u] spawn frequency has been raised from +50% to +75% speed
[*] No other changes have been made
[/list]

[h3]Miscellaneous[/h3]

Some other minor tweaks have been made. Please see the full patch notes for update below:

[list]
[*] External Camera has received improved lighting and visibility
[*] Made it more obvious that the statue in the Garden is a Statue
[*] Dark Mode is now slightly darker, but the flashlight is brighter and casts a longer beam
[*] Greatly improved visibility for B&W mode and Dark Mode in general, but especially in the back yard
[*] No more glowing blood! Blood has been changed to a new non-glowing and glossy texture.
[*] Fixed some other minor visual glitches
[*] An invisible anomaly in the bathroom has been stamped on and called names
[*] Hard Mode has been tweaked again - Last time I made it too easy. Hopefully it's more balanced this time. Spawn frequency has been increased from +50% to +75%
[/list]

[h2]Support[/h2]

For Midnight Monitor support, please feel free to drop a message in the game's Steam Forums.
For support on Discord, please join the official Viexi Games Discord at https://discord.gg/fPXs5YfBHH
Alternative you can email viexigames@gmail.com.

Coming soon will be updates to the game audio. The new level is also only a week or two away!

notes.title: Improved Anomaly Warning System + QoL Tweaks
notes.content:
Thank you for your continued support of Midnight Monitor!

Following recent feedback, some much needed Quality-of-Life and difficulty changes have been added to the game.

The largest changes are outlined below:

[list]
[i][h3]Hard mode has had its difficulty decreased significantly:[/h3][/i]
[*] Anomaly limit is no longer reduced, Anomaly spawn frequency is now 50% faster instead of 100% faster. The game still does not stop time when paused.
[*] This was changed as it has become increasingly evident that Hard Mode was simply too dang hard.
[*] Congratulations to everyone who unlocked any Hard Mode achievements prior to September 12th 2023!

[i][h3]Presence anomalies can no longer cause a game-over if they are correctly reported moments before they trigger a game-over:[/h3][/i]
[*] Almost every Presence Anomaly starts a countdown timer when spawned. Previously a Presence anomaly was able to cause a game-over if this countdown timer reached 0 even if a correct report was being submitted. This is no longer possible and the Presence will be removed before the Game Over can occur.

[i][h3]Reporting any anomaly correctly now pauses the Anomaly spawn timer:[/h3][/i]
[*] Similar to the above, if an Anomaly spawned and put you over the Active anomaly limit whilst a correct report was pending, it was still possible to achieve a game-over. This tends to leave players feeling robbed, and so this has also been fixed.

[i][h3]Material Anomalies have been significantly reduced in Curated Anomalies mode[/h3][/i]
[*] 0 - 1 Material Anomaly will be curated per shift until they are more finely balanced
[/list]

A change has also been made to the Active Anomaly Limit warning system.

[h2]But Why?[/h2]

Currently when you exceed over half of your Active anomaly limit (4 or more Active Anomalies), a pop-up warns you of this. This warning would display only once, and would not show again even if the player exceeds the limit a second time. This behaviour has not changed and this on-screen warning will still only display once.

However, knowing if you are currently in danger of hitting the Active Anomaly Limit even if this warning has already been displayed can still be helpful for some players who may dislike the feeling of pressure or stress that this state of uncertainty causes. Because of this I have made the following change:

Somewhere in the Modern House level is an object that will, [i][b]an unlimited number of times[/b][/i], warn you when you are currently over the warning threshold at any time.

This feature has been set up in this particular way (and not as a HUD icon or persistent overlay) to help balance the benefit that the feature grants. Keep your eyes peeled for anything [i]particularly useful looking...[/i] (Though, it isn't exactly a hidden secret).

As always thank you from the bottom of my heart for playing and enjoying Midnight Monitor as I work to improve the game in any way I can. Your ongoing support will make Midnight Monitor the best it can be and I'm so grateful for that.

If you have any issues with this update please reach out to me directly via viexigames@gmail.com, or join the Official Discord server for game discussion and Tech Support: https://discord.gg/fPXs5YfBHH

notes.title: Midnight Monitor is now Available!
notes.content:
You can find the game available for sale on its store page here!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2551780/Midnight_Monitor_Anomaly_Watch/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44506047/f29fbc9a04e26aa7f634669634757c7dbbbe8996.jpg[/img][/url]

The game is 20% off for the launch period so don't dally!


[h2]Firstly, Thank you[/h2]
To everybody whom has supported me up to this point in getting Midnight Monitor into a polished and releasable state - Thank you. For your support and for driving me to continue when things got tough. You helped push me through and Midnight Monitor is here to show for it now. I hope that everyone can be just as excited playing it as I was making it.

Please feel free to discuss the game on the official Discord here: https://discord.gg/yNMpcTtA
Or drop me an email with any feedback you might have here: viexigames@gmail.com


[h3]What can I expect from Midnight Monitor's launch version?[/h3]
Midnight Monitor is releasing in a completely playable state, with its Modern House level. The Modern House level contains 8 rooms, almost all filled with 20 - 40 anomalous objects that can vary wildly from Objects moving, to intruders breaking in and watching your television, and much more.

The secret sauce to this game is that most objects [u][i]can be affected by multiple anomaly types[/i][/u]. Maybe that cup moved in the last night, but this time it might Duplicate itself, or change colour, or grow or shrink or... You get the idea. This means that each playthrough of Midnight Monitor is almost entirely unique 100% of the time.

When you've memorised the layouts of each room, you might opt to play "Dark Mode", a version of the house with every light removed except for your trusty flashlight. This mode is creepy and completely changes the feel of the game. Give it a try! Or you might want to give Black & White mode a look - This is a more classic feeling version of the game that better aligns with the pioneers of this game genre.

Finally there is Hard Mode - This option makes the game drastically harder, doubles anomaly spawn rates and reduces the number of anomalies that can be active before causing a Game Over 😱 Good luck!

The game also supports an option called "Curated Anomalies":

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44506047/ab1b0c2e53d27d4d22cdba85e46cb0c2f77509fc.png[/img]

Curated Anomalies is designed to make sure that you get a good representation of each anomaly type per game - This means that you are much more likely to see Presence Anomalies, Corpses, and other rare anomaly types. This mode comes highly recommended!

[h3]What's new for launch?[/h3]
The last few weeks have seen me add and complete the Garden and Basement areas each with their own spooky anomalies, but I'm not done with them yet! Expect there to be more anomalies and refinements to each area as development of Midnight Monitor continues. I posted an initial showing of these areas here if you want to see some extra screenshots: https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2551780/view/3658665545034692293

I am always adding features and refinements to Midnight Monitor; in the last week alone I have added 37 Achievements that can be unlocked in the game! These range from reporting anomalies, losing the game, winning in each of the game modes and more.

Here are 4 of my favourite Achievement icons - Each one earned for missing more and more anomalies at the end of each night:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44506047/a97e5215a0c1f632536025fc0dc9899b9f155f26.jpg[/img]

The game also supports both Steam Stats and Cloud saving too! So no matter where you go, you will always have access to both your in-game stats and your Achievement Progress. More Achievements are planned as the game increases in scope!

[h3]What's next?[/h3]
I am also continuing to work on "Neighbourhood Watch". This map plans to be a neighbourhood full of houses and full of exciting new game mechanics! The game currently includes a demo house from the Neighbourhood Watch map for demonstration purposes - The map itself does not currently have any anomalies, but check it out and let me know what you think!

I am also going to begin working on optimising the game further - Due to the way the lighting in Midnight Monitor works (using completely realtime lights in most cases to facilitate Dark Mode), it can be pretty heavy at times. The game currently runs on Steam Deck but uses more power than it should - This is being worked on as I continue to home my skills as a "Pretty Good Game Dev™️"

On top of this Neighbourhood Watch will have its own unique style separate from the Modern House, with new menus, new looks, new sounds, etc... Keep your eyes peeled for further updates!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44506047/593ad14f042317dffc27eba70ccd8614cd2384b1.jpg[/img]

[h3]What can I do to help Midnight Monitor's development?[/h3]
As Midnight Monitor is an Early Access game from a solo developer, getting feedback from the community at this stage is going to be absolutely vital to make it the best game that it can be, but also to make it something that both I and the community can be really proud of.

If you are able to stream or record your gameplay on Twitch or YouTube to share with your audiences, I fully support and encourage that you do so! The game uses entirely free, royalty free sound effects and music so you do not need to worry about any copyright issues - Doing this will allow the game to reach a wider audience and will be a huge benefit to its development and my ability to pour more resources into Midnight Monitor.

There is currently a Feedback section for Midnight Monitor open on the Discussion forums:
https://steamcommunity.com/app/2551780/discussions/0/3825299103409816236/


I will also be on hand on the official Discord to take feedback, suggestions and to offer any support for the game:
https://discord.gg/yNMpcTtA


Finally if you want to leave any feedback by email, you can also do so by emailing viexigames@gmail.com


For anyone interested in further supporting development of the game, I will open up some additional funding options in the coming weeks - These are completely optional and will not affect any in-game features.


[h2]Once again, thank you[/h2]
I know I've said that already but I cannot overstate how important your ongoing support is. Creating Midnight Monitor has been a humbling experience and I am incredibly proud of what I have created - I hope that it can grow to become 10x bigger than it is even today with all of your help and support.

Enjoy Midnight Monitor!
